title: 2 Samuel Bible Quiz - Chapter 8
description: Ten questions on 2 Samuel 8: David's victories over the Philistines, Moab, Zobah, Syria and Edom, and the officials of his kingdom.

questions.text: What did David take out of the hand of the Philistines?
questions.explanation: David struck the Philistines, subdued them, and took the bridle of the mother city out of their hand.

answers.text: The bridle of the mother city

questions.text: How did David measure the Moabites with the line?
questions.explanation: He measured two lines to put to death, and one full line to keep alive.

answers.text: Two lines to put to death and one full line to keep alive
One line to put to death and two lines to keep alive
All of the lines were kept alive as servants
Every tenth man in each line was put to death

questions.text: Of which kingdom was Hadadezer the son of Rehob king?
questions.explanation: David struck Hadadezer the son of Rehob, king of Zobah.

questions.text: How many men of the Syrians of Damascus did David strike when they came to help Hadadezer?
questions.explanation: When the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadadezer, David struck twenty two thousand men of the Syrians.

questions.text: What did David take from the servants of Hadadezer and bring to Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadadezer and brought them to Jerusalem.

questions.text: What did King David take from Betah and Berothai?
questions.explanation: From Betah and Berothai, cities of Hadadezer, King David took a great quantity of bronze.

questions.text: Whom did Toi king of Hamath send to greet and bless David?
questions.explanation: Toi sent Joram his son to King David, to greet him and bless him, with vessels of silver, gold, and bronze.

questions.text: Where did David strike down eighteen thousand men of the Syrians?
questions.explanation: David earned a reputation when he returned from striking down eighteen thousand men of the Syrians in the Valley of Salt.

questions.text: What did David execute for all his people as he reigned over all Israel?
questions.explanation: David reigned over all Israel, and David executed justice and righteousness for all his people.

answers.text: A new law of the sabbath

questions.text: Who was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites?
questions.explanation: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites.
